A-forward.hypotheses: P : Prop; h : False ↔ P; hP : P
A-forward.inference: Apply h.mpr to hP and discharge hP into the resulting False.
A-forward.downstream_uses: Left-to-right branch of the composition root.
A-forward.exceptional_cases: None; both source assumptions are consumed.
A-forward.trust_boundary: Primitive implication and biconditional elimination only.

A-reverse.inference: Construct False → P by false elimination and P → False by h.
A-reverse.downstream_uses: Right-to-left branch of the composition root.
A-reverse.exceptional_cases: The impossible False input is handled by False.elim.
A-reverse.trust_boundary: Primitive false elimination and implication introduction only.

A-composition.hypotheses: P : Prop, instantiated by the complete frozen right-hand side.
A-composition.inference: Pair PU-forward and PU-reverse with biconditional introduction.
A-composition.downstream_uses: Statement crosswalk, machine closure, and provisional release.
A-composition.exceptional_cases: No omitted branch or exceptional parameter case.
A-composition.trust_boundary: Only the two audited proof units; provider theorem body excluded.
